audit_items.proof_trace: TOCTOU race between deduplication check (L157) and cache insertion (subscriber_data_column_sidecar.go::L42). The seen-check at L157 occurs BEFORE final proposer verification (L164), but cache update happens AFTER acceptance in the async subscriber. Two identical messages arriving concurrently can both pass the seen-check, complete full validation in parallel, and both be accepted before either updates the cache.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends duplicate data column sidecars to multiple peers simultaneously. Due to TOCTOU gap, both messages pass L157 seen-check, complete expensive KZG verification (L148), pass proposer check (L164), return ValidationAccept, and invoke the subscriber which performs chain operations (ReceiveDataColumn). Node wastes resources on duplicate cryptographic verification and may process the same data column twice before cache updates.
